reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend and adds recurConfigToExdates next to recurConfigToRSchedule, so every move site reuses the shared function.

duplication.why: The off-day move logic exists once, but the holidays argument and the new exdates wiring are repeated at each RSchedule/move call site instead of being carried by the config-to-schedule helper.

placement.why: Rule logic sits in shared/schedules.ts where weekend handling already lives; the daily exclusion is a separate helper rather than part of recurConfigToRSchedule's own daily weekend branch.

scope.why: Focused on the holiday rule, its type, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: The daily-skip half of the rule depends on every RSchedule construction remembering to pass recurConfigToExdates (find-schedules.ts does not), and the weekend-skip for daily stays in recurConfigToRSchedule while holidays live elsewhere.

one_place.where: moving is centralised in getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but the daily skip is a separate recurConfigToExdates that each RSchedule constructor must add (rule-utils.ts, schedules/app.ts twice; find-schedules.ts is not updated), and getDatesInRange tweaks its own margin
